items.diagram_kind: factorization ladder of a birational surface morphism into point blowups
items.selection_reason: The theorem spells out a finite compositional ladder X₀=Y,…,Xₙ≅X where each arrow is a point blowup; an indexed factorization diagram is a concrete aid to the statement.
items.concrete_diagram_content_or_checks: Verify each b_i:X_i→X_{i−1} is the blowup at the stated regular closed point, the composite equals f up to the terminal isomorphism, and directions/indexing align.

source_lines.53: Assume the Axiom of Choice. Let $k$ be a field and let $X$ and $Y$ be integral regular finite-type $k$-schemes
source_lines.54: of pure dimension two that are proper over $k$ (for instance smooth projective surfaces over $k$). Then every
source_lines.55: birational morphism $f\colon X\to Y$ is a composition of blowups at closed points and an isomorphism: there are
source_lines.56: schemes $X_0=Y,X_1,\dots,X_n$ with $X_n\cong X$ over $Y$, closed points $y_{i-1}\in X_{i-1}$ with
source_lines.57: $\mathcal O_{X_{i-1},y_{i-1}}$ regular of dimension two, and morphisms $X_i=\operatorname{Bl}_{y_{i-1}}X_{i-1}
source_lines.58: \to X_{i-1}$ whose composition $X\to Y$ is $f$ up to the isomorphism $X\cong X_n$.
